newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds were immune to a slightly stronger tone in U.S. Treasuries but also managed to resist some of German bonds' decline.

"We had little turnover. We deflected all impulses from without and within," said one trader, adding the market's self-absorbed tone may be tied to the Swiss government's next bond tender, slated for May 22.

The trader added the Swiss yield curve flattened. Medium-term maturities saw more pressure than the long end. In view of this, a second trader added the market hoped the Swiss Treasury would bring a longer maturity in the tender.
As expected, the Swiss National Bank left its discount rate unchanged at its latest meeting of its central bank council.
No change in the rate was expected.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 down five at 111.65
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 down one at 98.19.
